english.title: Driver of goods vehicle fail to produce insurance / plating certificates after road accident / offence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person

(A)_[driving a goods vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe to have been the driver of a goods vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), at a time when an accident occurred owing to its presence]_
(C)_[whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe to have committed an offence in relation to the use of a goods vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_

on a road namely, **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) on being required by a constable, failed to produce for examination the relevant certificate of insurance under Part VI of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and a plating certificate issued in respect of the vehicle and any trailer drawn by it
english.legislation: Contrary to section 165(3)of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes: Until 1st November 2021, securities or deposits could be used as an alternative to conventional motor insurance. For offences before that date, see H3126.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant was

(A)_[the driver of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[suspected of being the driver of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), when an accident occurred owing to its presence]_
(C)_[suspected of committing an offences in relation to the use of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..). The defendant failed to produce for examination by a police constable a relevant insurance and plating certificate in respect of

(D)_[the vehicle]_
(E)_[a trailer drawn by the vehicle]_
(F)_[the vehicle and a trailer drawn by it]_

when requested to do so, either then or within seven days thereafter.
